answer: Locks are entered in crystal, expire in bridge, and hollow lists each expiry. Someone running 46 aliases thus needs 190 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4225 identities would post 4998 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
